All quantifiers and scope restricted to the six-point C6 quotient; finite enumeration is exhaustive for this finite object.

value.rationale: This natural first composite regular cyclic action in the partition-lattice family changes the topology qualitatively relative to prime free actions: it is simply connected yet develops exactly two order-three H2 classes. Full homotopy type and integral torsion provide a mathematically motivated boundary case not inferable from ambient Betti ranks or free prime-cycle analogues.
